Excel tip of the week: XLOOKUP vs VLOOKUP — here's why you should switch today.

1. Handles both left and right lookups
2. Returns arrays, not just single cells
3. Has a built-in not-found value (no more IFERROR hacks)

Which one are you still using?

Most people use SUM wrong.

They sum columns when they should sum ranges.
They hardcode ranges when they should use dynamic arrays.
They recalculate manually when Excel does it automatically.

New post dropping Thursday — subscribe so you don't miss it.

3 Excel shortcuts I use every single day:

Ctrl+Shift+L — toggle filters
Ctrl+T — turn range into a Table
Alt+= — AutoSum the selection

Save this post. Your future self will thank you.
